GP01.method: GHG Protocol avoided emissions: current ICE vehicle versus average BEV
assumptions: Baseline: petrol car, 3951.24 estimated km/year; the replacement BEV travels the same distance.
Mileage derives from road-fuel spend, average pump prices and derived fuel economy; charging is excluded.
Factors: petrol_car_avg_per_km, bev_car_avg_per_km, bev_car_avg_td_per_km; DESNZ GHG Conversion Factors 2026.
Use-phase estimate only; excludes manufacturing, financing, rebound and fuel upstream emissions.

GP02.method: GHG Protocol avoided emissions: gas boiler versus air-source heat pump
assumptions: Illustrative intervention: replace the gas boiler with an air-source heat pump for heating and hot water. A heat-loss survey would set the real design.
Baseline: 8,420 kWh/year of gas from bills in the feature window, all treated as heating and hot water (cooking gas is not separated).

Heat delivered = gas x 84% boiler in-situ efficiency (BEIS Improving boiler standards and efficiency impact assessment (IA BEIS067(C)-22-CHD)); heat pump electricity = heat / SPF 2.8 (Energy Systems Catapult Electrification of Heat Demonstration (DESNZ-funded), median).

Gas displaced 8,420 kWh minus heat pump electricity added 2,526 kWh = 5,894 kWh/year less purchased energy; emissions use natural_gas_per_kwh, grid_electricity_per_kwh and grid_electricity_td_per_kwh (DESNZ GHG Conversion Factors 2026).
Excludes refrigerant leakage, manufacturing, installation, fabric upgrades and rebound.

GP02.method: GHG Protocol avoided emissions: gas boiler versus air-source heat pump
assumptions: Illustrative intervention: replace the gas boiler with an air-source heat pump for heating and hot water. A heat-loss survey would set the real design.
Baseline: 17,167 kWh/year of gas from bills in the feature window, all treated as heating and hot water (cooking gas is not separated).

Heat delivered = gas x 84% boiler in-situ efficiency (BEIS Improving boiler standards and efficiency impact assessment (IA BEIS067(C)-22-CHD)); heat pump electricity = heat / SPF 2.8 (Energy Systems Catapult Electrification of Heat Demonstration (DESNZ-funded), median).

Baseline: 3,797 kWh/year of gas from bills in the feature window, all treated as heating and hot water (cooking gas is not separated).

Heat delivered = gas x 84% boiler in-situ efficiency (BEIS Improving boiler standards and efficiency impact assessment (IA BEIS067(C)-22-CHD)); heat pump electricity = heat / SPF 2.8 (Energy Systems Catapult Electrification of Heat Demonstration (DESNZ-funded), median).

Gas displaced 3,797 kWh minus heat pump electricity added 1,139 kWh = 2,658 kWh/year less purchased energy; emissions use natural_gas_per_kwh, grid_electricity_per_kwh and grid_electricity_td_per_kwh (DESNZ GHG Conversion Factors 2026).
Excludes refrigerant leakage, manufacturing, installation, fabric upgrades and rebound.
Gas use is apportioned from a dual-fuel bill (D6), so the baseline is less certain.

GP02.method: GHG Protocol avoided emissions: gas boiler versus air-source heat pump
assumptions: Illustrative intervention: replace the gas boiler with an air-source heat pump for heating and hot water. A heat-loss survey would set the real design.

Excludes refrigerant leakage, manufacturing, installation, fabric upgrades and rebound.
